400.title: Azerbaijan, Türkiye, Georgia, Bulgaria sign clean energy pact at COP31
400.summary: Moving beyond broad climate pledges, discussions at the Azerbaijan Pavilion highlighted the proposed green energy routes and strategic Azerbaijan-Türkiye energy interconnection as critical drivers of cross-border infrastructure.
400.body: Azerbaijan has put 'Green Energy Corridors' at the top of its agenda at the COP31 climate summit in Antalya.The goal is to physically integrate renewable grids across multiple countries and establish a direct electricity transit route from the Caspian Sea to European markets. The country has formed a new alliance with Türkiye, Georgia and Bulgaria, who all signed the multi-state Strategic Partnership Agreement in Clean Energy. Moving beyond broad climate pledges, discussions at the Azerbaijan Pavilion highlighted the proposed green energy routes and strategic Azerbaijan-Türkiye energy interconnection as critical drivers of cross-border infrastructure. Azerbaijan's Energy Minister Parviz Shahbazov, Türkiye's Minister of Energy and Natural Resources Alparslan Bayraktar, Georgia's Vice Prime Minister, Minister of Economy and Sustainable Development Mariam Kvrivishvili, and Bulgaria's Minister of Energy Iva Petrova signed the document on 10 November 2026.

500.title: Google adds multi-model Orchestrator, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, to Antigravity
500.summary: Google is adding a new feature, Orchestrator, to Antigravity, its AI-powered development environment, to help enterprises improve software development efficiency by automatically coordinating multiple Gemini models, including the newly introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen.
500.body: Google is adding a new feature, Orchestrator, to Antigravity, its AI-powered development environment, to help enterprises improve software development efficiency by automatically coordinating multiple Gemini models, including the newly introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen. The new feature, which allows developers to delegate planning, coding, and review tasks to different models within a single coding session, combines a planning model, such as Gemini 4 Carbon or Argon, with Hydrogen, which the hyperscaler describes as a lighter execution model. Currently, the hyperscaler offers Orchestrator with Carbon as the planner model to Google AI Ultra subscribers, while Orchestrator with Argon as the planner is available to both Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers. Developers, the hyperscaler added, also have the option of selecting Gemini 4 Hydrogen separately as a singular option for tasks that don’t require a planner model in Antigravity.
